      <h1>Team Readiness Scorecard &mdash; Eight Dimensions, Scored Honestly</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A per-team scorecard: the 1-2 dimensions flagged as blockers before this team touches agent work, and a quarterly reassessment date.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-06-team-readiness-scorecard</b><br>
      Pack A - Groundwork (pre-work)<br>

  <div class="ws-source">

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    <b>Panel A &mdash; one sheet per candidate team. Score alone, before anyone compares.</b>
    Team lead: with a senior engineer who has actually reviewed agent-generated code, score each of the nine
    dimensions 1-5 against the printed anchors. Write the evidence behind each mark; a score with no evidence is an opinion.
    Tick <i>blocker</i> wherever you scored 1 or 2, then write a remediation action, a named owner and a target date.
    Write the team's name in the foot line. The back of this sheet carries the bands and the adoption posture strip.
  </div>

      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="prior"><b>Knowledge explicitness</b><span class="prior-src">ch06 L345-352</span></td>
          <td class="prior">What percentage of your team's working knowledge is documented vs. tribal?<span class="prior-src">ch06 L345-352</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-scale"><span class="pt">1</span><span class="pt">2</span><span class="pt">3</span><span class="pt">4</span><span class="pt">5</span></div></td>
          <td class="prior">1 = almost all tribal; 5 = comprehensive docs<span class="prior-src">ch06 L345-352</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="1-2 NR &middot; 3 PR &middot; 4-5 R"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="prior" style="font-size:6.8pt;padding:.6mm 1mm;margin-bottom:.8mm">Is there a written architecture document a new hire could use? Are coding standards documented or only enforced in review? Can someone unfamiliar with the project run the build and tests from documentation alone?<span class="prior-src">ch08 L33</span></div><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-checkline"><span class="f-check"></span>blocker</span></td>
          <td class="prior">&#9745; pre-ticked: unblocks everything else<span class="prior-src">ch06 L358</span></td>

          <td class="fill"><div class="f-scale"><span class="pt">1</span><span class="pt">2</span><span class="pt">3</span><span class="pt">4</span><span class="pt">5</span></div></td>
          <td class="prior">1 = no experience; 5 = structured review process<span class="prior-src">ch06 L345-352</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="1-2 NR &middot; 3 PR &middot; 4-5 R"></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="prior" style="font-size:6.8pt;padding:.6mm 1mm;margin-bottom:.8mm">Can reviewers articulate <i>why</i> code is wrong, not just that it looks wrong?<span class="prior-src">ch08 L45</span></div><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>

        <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">15</span></td><td><b>Work reserved for manual implementation</b></td>

          <td class="fill taller"><span class="f-box lg"></span><br><i style="font-size:6.8pt;color:#454f59">the named categories this team commits to keep writing by hand</i></td></tr>
